name: Constantin Valdor
subtitle: Captain-General of the Legio Custodes
factionLine: Adeptus Custodes • Legio Custodes • Horus Heresy

abilities.name: Faction — Martial Ka'tah
abilities.text: At the start of your Command phase, this unit is readied. While it is readied, you can select one ka'tah ability for it to use; it is then no longer readied.

abilities.name: Faction — Aegis of the Emperor
abilities.text: This unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Master of the Golden Legion
abilities.text: In the first battle round, enemy units within 12" of one or more friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY or MOUNTED units have -1 to battle-shock rolls. Once per battle, in your first Movement phase, one friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit with Deep Strike that is in strategic reserves can make an ingress move.

abilities.name: Golden Exemplar
abilities.text: At the start of the battle round, if this model is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

abilities.name: Eternal Warrior
abilities.text: Attacks allocated to this model have -1 D.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.text: This model can be attached to the following units: Custodian Guard Sodality, Sentinel Guard Sodality, Custodian Wardens.

keywords: INFANTRY, CHARACTER, EPIC HERO, IMPERIUM, LEADER, CONSTANTIN VALDOR

name: Jenetia Krole
subtitle: The Soulless Queen — Oblivion Knight-Centura
factionLine: Anathema Psykana • Talons of the Emperor • Horus Heresy

abilities.name: Faction — Daughters of the Abyss
abilities.text: This unit has Feel No Pain 3+ against psychic attacks. Psychic Null (Aura): friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units within 6" of this unit have Feel No Pain 5+ against psychic attacks.

abilities.name: Creeping Dread (Aura)
abilities.text: In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, each enemy unit within 12" of this unit that is a PSYKER unit or is below its starting strength makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

abilities.name: The Soulless Queen
abilities.text: This model's melee attacks that target a PSYKER or CHARACTER unit have +1 to wound rolls.

abilities.name: Ex Oblivio
abilities.text: At the end of the Fight phase, roll one D6 for each enemy PSYKER unit engaged with this model's unit: on a 2+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.text: This model can be attached to the following units: Prosecutor Squad, Vigilator Squad, Witchseeker Squad.

keywords: INFANTRY, CHARACTER, EPIC HERO, IMPERIUM, ANATHEMA PSYKANA, LEADER, JENETIA KROLE
